Bug Bounty

Self-funded, paid in INR (or USD/EUR/GBP equivalent). Effective 28 May 2026.

Severity bands

SeverityExamplePayout (INR)
CriticalDecrypt a vault you don't own; forge a release; bypass the 14-day hold; auth bypass to admin; RCE₹1,00,000 – ₹3,00,000
HighLock out another user; trigger alerts on someone else's vault; tamper with audit log; bypass free-tier; XSS with session theft₹25,000 – ₹75,000
MediumCSRF on state-changing endpoint; high-precision account enumeration; IDOR on non-secret resources₹5,000 – ₹20,000
LowOpen redirect; reflected XSS on logged-out pages; security-header weakness with demo₹1,000 – ₹5,000

Multipliers

  • +50% with a working fix we accept
  • +50% for protocol-level breaks (crypto, release engine, Shamir)
  • +100% for demonstrated multi-user compromise
  • -50% if the precondition is a documented risk (e.g. sharing the master passphrase)
  • -50% for duplicates within 72 hours

Payment

Within 30 days of fix deployment via UPI / bank transfer (India) or Wise (international). Indian recipients above ₹30,000/year receive a TDS Form 16A per IT Act §194J.

Out of scope

See the disclosure policy.
